scripts.dev:web: sh -c 'cd apps/web && PORT="${HETQML_WEB_PORT:-3000}" pnpm exec next dev'
scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn hetqml_api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${HETQML_API_PORT:-8000}"'
scripts.verify: pnpm --filter hetqml-web typecheck && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:api
